# HireMind

Pay an AI seller agent on-chain, get a research brief with receipt.
Built for SERV Hackathon 02, Open Track, on the OpenServ agent network.

Live at https://hiremind-orpin.vercel.app (host in app/layout.tsx,
app/robots.ts, app/sitemap.ts, and this file).

## Pages

- / is the marketing landing: hero, how it works, real delivered briefs, price, FAQ
- /brief is the buy flow: topic field, 0.01 KITE payment on Kite testnet
  (chain 2368), on-chain verification, brief plus receipt
- /privacy is the privacy note: no tracking, no accounts

## API

- GET /api/brief returns price info, seller address, build version, delivered count
- POST /api/brief with a topic answers 402 with price and seller address
- POST /api/brief with a topic and txHash verifies payment on-chain, then delivers
  the brief plus receipt. Each hash pays out exactly once.

## Notes for judges

- Settlement is x402-style (402, pay, verify, deliver), not the full x402
  facilitator flow. Settlement is fully on Kite testnet.
- Receipts honestly label the generation path: SERV Reasoning via the
  OpenServ runtime, or a labeled direct fallback.
- Kite testnet: chain ID 2368, RPC https://rpc-testnet.gokite.ai,
  faucet https://faucet.gokite.ai, explorer https://testnet.kitescan.ai.

## Repo

Seller agent in agent/ (OpenServ SDK, run-less capability research_brief).
Web app in app/ (Next.js, Viem). See README.md for setup.
